name: npentane
rationale: n-Pentane; lipophilic alkane, anesthetic only at lethal doses (>10% atm)

name: methanol
rationale: Methanol; very weak anesthetic, requires lethal concentrations for narcosis

name: benzene
rationale: Benzene; weak narcotic at high concentrations; not used clinically

name: cis_12_dichloroethylene
rationale: cis-1,2-dichloroethylene; anesthetic conformer of trans-DCE; tests pipeline shape sensitivity

name: cyclohexane
rationale: Cyclohexane; saturated cyclic alkane, weak narcotic at high concentrations

name: hexafluoroethane
rationale: Hexafluoroethane; halogenated alkane similar to volatile anesthetics in size/halogenation but non-anesthetic per Eger 1997
